values: As-of: 2026-08-31 | Fictional scenario — internal analyst workbook
1) All editable assumptions are on the 'Assumptions' sheet, shaded YELLOW. Change any yellow cell and every other sheet recalculates.
2) The 'Underwriting' sheet computes T12 historical, underwritten scenario, and capitalization value.
3) The 'Loan Sizing' sheet solves LTV / DSCR / Debt Yield constraints, picks the binding minimum, and returns Sources & Uses and cash to borrower.
4) The 'Sensitivity' sheet runs (a) EGI −5% + sizing rate +100 bps combined downside (cap rate unchanged) and (b) cap rate +50 bps standalone.
5) The 'Rent Roll' sheet holds the unit-level detail supporting the in-place monthly base.
6) Yellow = editable input · Green = calculated output · Orange = binding constraint highlight.
7) Every sizing formula uses named ranges (see Formulas tab in Excel > Name Manager) so the intent is auditable.
